facts.text: The hotel is in Valladolid province, in the heart of the Ribera del Duero wine region.
facts.excerpt: Luxury hotel in Valladolid, in the heart of the Ribera del Duero region

facts.text: The hotel is a former 12th-century Romanesque abbey converted into a hotel.
facts.excerpt: A former 12th century Romanesque abbey converted into a unique experiential destination

facts.text: Abadia Retuerta is less than two hours from Madrid, in the Duero Valley.
facts.excerpt: Less than two hours from Madrid and in the heart of the Duero Valley stands Abadía Retuerta.

facts.text: The property sits on an estate of 700 hectares.
facts.excerpt: It has an estate of 700 hectares

facts.text: All of the rooms overlook the vineyards.
facts.excerpt: all of them overlooking a sea of vineyards.

facts.text: The hotel has an art collection with Renaissance, Baroque and modern pieces, including a sculpture by Eduardo Chillida.
facts.excerpt: with a Renaissance, Baroque and modern collection to which is added its natural heritage and its latest sculptural guest, a work by the artist Eduardo Chillida.

facts.text: Guests have a butler service available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Full 24-hour butler service

facts.text: The hotel offers a pillow menu.
facts.excerpt: An exclusive pillow menu

facts.text: An a la carte breakfast is included in the room rate.
facts.excerpt: an à la carte breakfast included in the room rate

facts.text: A shuttle service is available on request, and bicycles are provided for guests.
facts.excerpt: a shuttle service upon request, bicycles for guests

facts.text: Refectorio is the hotel's Michelin-starred fine-dining restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Non-residents can make reservations at Refectorio, our Michelin-starred fine-dining restaurant

facts.text: Vinoteca is a contemporary Castilian tavern that reinterprets tradition and local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: at Vinoteca, our contemporary Castilian tavern, where tradition and local ingredients are reinterpreted with a modern twist

facts.text: Calicata Terroir Bar is a wine bar in the winery, open during the summer season.
facts.excerpt: at Calicata Terroir Bar, our wine bar located in the winery, which is open during the summer season

facts.text: Santuario Wellness and Spa is set underground in the old stables, with entrances that bring in natural light.
facts.excerpt: located in the old stables area underground, but with several entrances that guarantee 80% of natural light

facts.text: The spa offers a Spa Sommelier concept that blends wellness with wine culture.
facts.excerpt: the Spa Sommelier—a unique concept that blends wellness with wine culture through specialized treatments

facts.text: The spa has a Spa Suite, a private space for couples to enjoy treatments together.
facts.excerpt: the Spa Suite, a private space designed for couples to enjoy treatments and experiences together

facts.text: The wellness offer also includes a gym and a yoga room.
facts.excerpt: the wellness offer is completed with other services such as the gym and the yoga room.

facts.text: Spa access for children under 16 is restricted to set hours and conditions.
facts.excerpt: access to the Sanctuary is restricted to minors under the age of 16, except during the established hours and conditions.

facts.text: Since May 2022 the estate has had its own Protected Designation of Origin for its wine.
facts.excerpt: Since May 2022, Abadía Retuerta has had its own Protected Designation of Origin: the Abadía Retuerta PDO.

facts.text: The winery's main grape varieties are Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot and Sauvignon Blanc.
facts.excerpt: The main grape varieties used are Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot, and Sauvignon Blanc.

facts.text: The estate produces wine salt, flower honey from its own beehives, and pine nuts.
facts.excerpt: wine salt, flower honey harvested from our beehives, and pine nuts

facts.text: The abbey has vaulted ceilings, thick stone walls and a silent cloister.
facts.excerpt: vaulted ceilings, thick stone walls, and a silent cloister

facts.text: Diners at Refectorio can see peeling frescoes while working through a prix-fixe menu.
facts.excerpt: Examine the peeling frescoes while you make your way through a prix-fixe menu

facts.text: Breakfast, coffee and the other facilities and services are reserved for hotel guests; non-residents can only book lunch and dinner.
facts.excerpt: For non-residents, the offerings are limited to lunch and dinner, while breakfast, coffee, and the rest of the facilities and services are reserved exclusively for guests.

facts.text: The hotel hosts celebrations such as intimate weddings, anniversaries and family gatherings.
facts.excerpt: intimate weddings, engagement parties, anniversaries, family gatherings, and corporate events

facts.text: The spa's water comes from a well 120 meters deep.
facts.excerpt: the water is extracted from a well 120 meters deep
